text: Added typed NeuralInput.either and reg.neuralInputEither plus compatible throwing facades. Reuses 1,000,001-sample portable grid cap; refuses non-finite endpoints/event ends, reversed or overflowing spans and invalid resolution before Int conversion/allocation. Floating block bins clip before conversion and iteration; outside impulses skip without saturation. Preserves fractional tail bins, inclusive block ends, amplitude and summate-independent preview semantics. 13 focused tests pass JVM+JS, both bounded old-count mutations fail as expected, and restored source passes. Integrated gates passed: HRF352/352, design455/454, fit660/603, admission4/4 (2,884 total), no compiler warnings. Evidence docs/verification/neural-input-budget-20261005/receipt.json links docs/verification/grid-safety-20261005/receipt.json. Clipping bounds each event to admitted bins; total preview work still scales with events and covered bins. Source/archive hashes preserved.
